label: not replicated
note: Seed-7 graded-moves win (19/6, p=0.015) reversed at seed 8 (14/16, p=0.86); frontier suggestive only (Fisher p=0.04).
result: On the first training run it looked like a win: better move counts on the standard exam. On the second run with a different random start, the effect reversed. The small hard-exam improvement was within run-to-run noise.
conclusion: Not adopted. The improvement did not survive re-testing. This is why we re-test every win before we believe it.
